The black bocal (mouthpiece) is in his mouth, connected to the instrument which extends downwards out of frame. To the left, another musician's profile is partially visible. In the background, there is a blurred figure of a woman. A music stand is in the foreground.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the instrument is indeed a bassoon and not a similar woodwind like an oboe or clarinet, given the partial view.
To analyze the subtle texture anomalies in the skin, hair, and clothing for signs of AI generation artifacts.

Check if the lips look naturally pursed around the bocal or if they melt into it. Also, verify if the visible keywork matches the standard layout of a bassoon's upper joint.
